newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DILEMMA FOR HODDLE IF UNITED GET TO MUNICH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DILEMMA FOR HODDLE IF UNITED GET TO MUNICH.

text.p: England manager Glenn Hoddle could face a major selection headache if Manchester United reach this season's European Cup final.
The final is due to played in Munich on May 28 -- three days before England face Poland in Chorzow in a vital World Cup qualifier.
United will hope to have England internationals David Beckham and Gary and Philip Neville in their squad for what would be their biggest match since 1968 when they won the European Cup at Wembley.
Unfortunately for United manager Alex Ferguson, Hoddle would almost certainly name them in his international squad and would ideally want them in the England camp in the days before the Poland match.
The English Football Association said on Tuesday the potential conflict of interests between club and country would be discussed, and hopefully resolved, nearer the time.

"It's a question for the two managers to decide on further down the line," a spokeswoman said. "We're not really able to comment on it at present as it's not yet a reality. It could be discussed before the (European Cup) semifinal."
She said the date of the Poland-England match -- the only European World Cup qualifier scheduled for May 31 -- could not be changed.

Manchester United, who declined to comment on the potential problem, are almost certain of a place in the European Cup semifinals after their 4-0 defeat of Porto in the first leg of their quarter-final tie.
